entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • MAUI Blazor single-file publish breaks WebView with ERR_ADDRESS_UNREACHABLE #32462
  • MAUI Fails To Convert Valid SVG Files Into PNG Files (Object reference not set to an instance of an object) #32460
  • .NET 10 RC2 MauiXamlInflator - SourceGen binding issue to non-nullable properties in nullable object properties #32459
  • [NET 10 regression, Android] Back button crashes the app #32458
  • Image source swaps thrash layout under fixed constraints, tanking frame rate when scrolling virtualized collections #32457

Closed

  • [Android] Setting SafeAreaEdges SoftInput on bottom causes padding from bottom bar #31870
